entries.title: Tell HN: Fiverr left customer files public and searchable
entries.author: morpheuskafka
entries.current_title: Tell HN: Fiverr left customer files public and searchable
entries.excerpt: Fiverr (gig work/task platform, competitor to Upwork) uses a service called Cloudinary to process PDF/images in messaging, including work products from the worker to client. Besides the PDF processing value add, Cloudinary effectively acts like S3 here, serving assets directly to the web client. Like S3, it has support for signed/expiring URLs. entries.guide_zh: 发帖者称 Fiverr 客户文件公开可被搜索，关注外部文件处理服务带来的泄露。
